Reporting Manager Title : Senior Associate Technical Consultant, Water Scientist

Technical Consultant, Water Scientist

Play an integral role in Worley’s Environmental & Sustainability (E&S) team, supporting critical environmental monitoring programs for a leading oil sands operation in Fort McMurray, Alberta. This is an exciting early‑career opportunity to contribute to sustainable resource development while gaining hands‑on field experience, collaborating with experienced professionals, and building a strong foundation in environmental consulting.

Working within a multidisciplinary team, you will help collect, manage, and communicate environmental data that supports regulatory compliance, environmental stewardship, and informed decision-making. Your contributions will directly support safe, efficient, and high‑quality project delivery while advancing your technical and professional development.

Purpose of the role

Join our dynamic team as a Technical Consultant, Water Scientist . In this role, you will support environmental field programs focused on groundwater and surface water monitoring for a major oil sands operation. You will work closely with experienced technical specialists and project teams to execute environmental monitoring activities, maintain high safety standards, and deliver reliable data and reporting that support our client’s environmental commitments and business objectives.

This position provides a unique opportunity to develop technical expertise, gain exposure to complex environmental projects, and establish a rewarding career within one of the world’s leading consulting and professional services organizations.

Location: Fort McMurray, Alberta, Canada

This role follows a 14 - days - on , 14-days-off rotation , including mobilization and demobilization . Accommodation is provided at a lodge near the client site during rotations, and travel is required to support environmental field programs . Candidates may be based in Edmonton or Calgary and fly in/out to Fort McMurray.

You will be responsible for

  • Supporting groundwater and surface water sampling and environmental monitoring programs in accordance with established procedures and project requirements.
  • Collecting, documenting, and managing field data accurately and efficiently while maintaining strong attention to detail.
  • Working under the guidance of experienced field supervisors and technical specialists to execute environmental monitoring activities safely and effectively.
  • Assisting in the preparation of technical reports, data summaries, and presentations for project teams and clients.
  • Supporting field activity tracking, documentation, and reporting requirements.
  • Participating actively in health, safety, and environmental programs, including safety meetings, hazard assessments, and field documentation.
  • Monitoring environmental and wildlife conditions, including bear awareness and observation activities, to help maintain safe field operations.
  • Maintaining compliance with client, regulatory, and Worley safety and quality requirements.
  • Collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to support successful project execution and delivery.
  • Representing Worley professionally while building positive working relationships with colleagues, contractors, and client stakeholders.

What you’ll bring to the role

  • Bachelor of Science, Bachelor of Engineering, Diploma in Natural Resource Science, Environmental Science, or a related discipline.
  • Environmental monitoring or environmental technician training is considered beneficial.
  • Junior or graduate-level experience supporting environmental field monitoring, sampling, data collection, or reporting activities.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills to communicate effectively with project teams and stakeholders.
  • Ability to work safely and productively in remote field environments and wilderness settings.
  • Physical capability to work outdoors, navigate uneven terrain, and perform field activities in varying weather conditions.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and commitment to delivering high‑quality work.
  • Collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively within team‑based project environments.
  • Previous environmental consulting experience is considered an asset.
  • Familiarity with Argo operation is considered an asset.

About Us

Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI‑enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today’s needs and transition to more sustainable solutions. Join us and help drive innovation and sustainability in our projects.

Moving forward together

We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values‑inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We’re building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.

And we’re not just talking about it; we’re doing it. We’re reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today’s low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there’s a path for you here. And there’s no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change. #LI-NM4

  • Liderança que assuma responsabilidade por decisões e resultados, promova o diálogo e o speak‑up e incorpore a avaliação de riscos e a segurança na priorização, no planejamento e no acompanhamento do trabalho da equipe.

O que está sendo oferecido:

  • Nossa Essência e Cultura: somos movidos por valores sólidos - agimos com integridade, operamos com excelência, cuidamos das pessoas e lideramos com coragem;
  • Segurança em Primeiro Lugar: a segurança não é apenas prioridade - é parte do nosso DNA. Cada atividade começa e termina com o compromisso de proteger o que importa;

The Alumar Consortium, managed by Alcoa, located 25 kilometers from the center of São Luís - MA, began its operations in 1984. It is made up of companies with a tradition in the areas of alumina and aluminum production, with different participations in the two factories that make up the Complex.

At Alcoa, we are committed to generating value in our relationships with all stakeholders in our business, communities and environment. We build inclusive and secure environments so that our people can live and express themselves as they please. With the aim of attracting and retaining diverse talent, the company maintains the inclusion groups that promote internal and external activities to value human diversity and plurality as a way of enriching one's own values.

We are values led, vision driven and united by our purpose of transforming raw potential into real progress. Our commitments to Inclusion, Diversity & Equity include providing trusting workplaces that are safe, respectful and inclusive of all individuals, free from discrimination, bullying and harassment and that our workplaces reflect the diversity of the communities in which we operate.

This is a place where you are empowered to do your best work, be your authentic self, and feel a true sense of belonging. Come join us and shape your career!

This professional acts as a key connector between operational monitoring, crisis response, and executive protection logistics, ensuring that all activities are executed with precision, discretion, and adherence to Nubank's safety standards.

The role requires a proactive mindset, attention to detail, and the ability to work under pressure while coordinating between multiple stakeholders and time-sensitive missions.

The analyst will monitor risk events in real time, support executive movements, and ensure that critical information is communicated accurately to the right teams, at the right time.

Role Tasks And Responsibilities

REMIR (Risk Event Monitoring & Incident Response)

  • Monitor real-time events that may impact operations, employees, or executives, ensure rapid assessment and escalation when required.
  • Draft and distribute alerts, notifications, and Situational Reports (SARs) through established communication channels, including Everbridge.
  • Coordinate with Facilities, Safety, and external emergency services during incidents to ensure an effective and aligned response.
  • Collect, validate, and analyze critical information from multiple sources, filtering noise and ensuring the accuracy of reports shared with GSOC leadership.
  • Support crisis management activities, including post-incident reporting and After-Action Reviews (AARs).

Executive Protection (EP)

  • Support the planning, monitoring, and execution of executive travel, events, and daily operations.
  • Monitor flight schedules, itineraries, and travel routes in real time, identifying potential disruptions, delays, or security concerns.
  • Conduct OSINT research to identify potential threats or risks affecting executive travel and activities.
  • Coordinate with vendors, drivers, and Executive Protection personnel to ensure operational readiness and seamless execution.
  • Provide real-time situational awareness and maintain continuous communication between GSOC and Executive Protection teams during missions.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of Executive Protection activities, including briefings, logistics records, and post-mission summaries.

Cross-Functional Support

  • Serve as a communication link between REMIR, Executive Protection, and other Corporate Security functions.
  • Collaborate with Strategic and Tactical Intelligence teams to ensure executive missions and crisis responses are supported by relevant intelligence insights.
  • Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of SOPs, playbooks, and communication protocols across REMIR and Executive Protection operations.
  • Support the Documentation and Quality Assurance Lead in maintaining process consistency and capturing lessons learned for ongoing operational improvement.

Requirements

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in International Relations, Security Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English; advanced Spanish is highly desirable.
  • Experience in security operations, crisis management, or executive protection support.
  • Familiarity with incident response tools (e.g., Everbridge), CCTV platforms, and access control systems.
  • Knowledge of OSINT methodologies and the ability to assess open-source data for risk identification.
  • Strong communication, coordination, and multitasking skills in high-pressure environments.
  • Proven attention to detail, discretion, and ability to handle sensitive information.

Desirable Skills

  • Experience working in corporate GSOCs or similar 24/7 operational environments.
  • Knowledge of risk assessment frameworks and executive security best practices.
  • Strong analytical skills and familiarity with reporting and visualization tools (Power BI, Looker Studio, etc.).
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with internal teams and external partners.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and make informed decisions during time-critical events.

title: Financial Service Representative em paraná (RN)
description:
Momentum Financial Services Group (formerly Money Mart Financial Services) is a leading North American financial services company and one of Canada’s top non-prime lenders. For more than 40 years, we’ve committed to helping consumers and business owners access the money they need when they need it most, meeting people where they are and helping close the gap between their financial needs and goals.

Through our trusted Money Mart® brand in Canada and United States, we proudly serve customers across a network of over 400 retail locations and growing digital channels. Our products and services include personal lending, payday loans, installment loans, cheque and check cashing, money transfers, prepaid cards, currency exchange, and other everyday financial solutions for individuals and businesses.

At Money Mart, we understand that not every customer fit with-in traditional banking or prime lending models. That’s why our teams look beyond the credit score to provide accessible, responsible financial solutions with respect, transparency, and care. Whether customers visit us online, in branch, or through our mobile app, we focus on delivering practical support, clear information, and service that helps people and business owners move forward with confidence.

We believe in giving back to the communities where we live and work. With the generous support of our customers and team members, we proudly contribute each year to local charities and nonprofit organizations, while also using our time and talent to serve local communities across Canada and the United States.

Our people are at the heart of our business. We’re committed to building inclusive teams, supporting the communities where we live and work, and creating a workplace where employees can grow, make an impact, and help customers navigate everyday financial needs. If you’re passionate about customer service, relationship building, and helping consumers and business owners access financial solutions when they need them most, you’ll find a meaningful career with Momentum Financial Services Group.

What we Offer:

  • Market competitive Pay
  • Monthly bonus potential based on the operational success you drive

Other Benefits Include:

  • Comprehensive Medical/Dental Benefits
  • Competitive Paid Time Off
  • Plan for your future with our group Retirement Options
  • Education Reimbursement Program to invest in your education and career growth.
  • Exclusive Perks through Perkopolis - enjoy special discounts and offers.
  • Free company services including cheque cashing, money orders, Telpay/bill payment, and prepaid Mastercard.
  • Discounted company services including foreign exchange and Koodo services.
  • And Much More!

Branch location: 264 Erie St South Unit B

GENERAL FUNCTION

Financial Service Representatives support Money Mart customers by understanding their financial needs and connecting them with suitable products and services. In this role, Team Members interview customers for personal lending products, review application and financial information, recommend appropriate solutions, sell related financial products and services, complete transactions, maintain accurate records, and support payment arrangements for existing accounts.

This role combines sales, customer service, personal lending, compliance, cash handling, and branch operations. Team Members must deliver excellent customer service while following company policies, regulatory requirements, and responsible lending practices.

Retail Team Members generally perform their duties within a secured work area protected by bullet-resistant glass and a controlled-access mantrap. Once hired, all retail Team Members will complete an internal multi-week Ready to Work Alone (RTWA) certification before working independently.

DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Provide friendly, professional, and accurate customer service by assessing customer needs, completing transactions, answering questions, and identifying opportunities to promote and cross-sell products and services.
  • Promote, recommend, and process loans, credit cards, cheque cashing, money transfers, money orders, bill payments, and other related products and services based on the customer’s needs, financial circumstances, and applicable company policies and regulatory requirements.
  • Consistently identify cross-selling and referral opportunities during every customer interaction to increase product awareness, meet customer needs, and achieve individual and branch sales goals.
  • Clearly explain product and service features, benefits, fees, repayment terms, payment options, renewals, refinancing options, and other important information using approved marketing materials.
  • Collect, review, verify, and document required customer identification, financial, application, and supporting information to process products and services, ensuring all applications/transactions are complete, compliant, and accurately recorded.
  • Monitor and maintain complete and accurate customer information and records in all required systems.
  • Contact customers with past-due accounts to discuss and negotiate payment arrangements within authorized guidelines.
  • Follow all company policies and regulatory requirements, including Know Your Customer (KYC), Anti-Money Laundering and Anti-Terrorist Financing (AML/ATF), privacy, Recordable Transactions, fraud prevention, and all relevant procedures.
  • Accurately process cash, POS transactions, and financial service transactions.
  • Reconcile the cash drawer at the end of each shift, and follow all cash handling, safety, and security procedures.
  • Work with the branch team to maintain the branch appearance, cleanliness, and customer-ready environment.
  • Support branch opening and closing procedures, including completing all required paperwork accurately.
  • Complete all other job-related duties as directed by Management.
  • Maintain availability to work flexible shifts, including evenings and weekends.

EDUCATION :

  • High School diploma or equivalent

WORK EXPERIENCE

  • One or more years of experience as a Retail Sales Associate, Sales Representative or similar role.
  • One or more years of experience in customer service and cash handling.
  • Hands-on experience with POS transactions.
  • Track record of achieving sales goals preferred.

SKILLS

  • Customer service-focused mindset with the ability to build rapport, deliver exceptional service, and create a positive customer experience.
  • Sales-focused approach with the ability to identify customer needs, recommend appropriate products and services, and achieve sales objectives through cross-selling opportunities.
  • Ability to perform effectively in a fast-paced environment, manage competing priorities, and perform well under pressure.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to identify customer needs, resolve concerns, and provide effective solutions in a professional and timely manner.
  • Proficiency in reading, writing, and speaking English with strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Basic knowledge and experience with Microsoft Office software (Excel, Word, and Outlook).

Please note: The pay range for this position is between $18.00 to $20.50 per hour with an additional monthly store bonus opportunity of up to $590 dependent on store size, individual performance and achievement of store KPIs.

About Money Mart – Our Commitment to Responsible Innovation

At Money Mart, we are committed to building innovative solutions grounded in ethical, transparent, and responsible use of data and technology. Aligned with the principles outlined in Canada’s Artificial Intelligence and Data Act (AIDA), we take a proactive approach to ensuring that any AI or data-driven systems we use are safe, fair, and accountable.

This posting is for a current positionwithin our organization, offering the opportunity to contribute to meaningful, responsible innovation that supports our employees, clients, and communities.

We prioritize strong data governance, clear communication around how systems work, and safeguards that reduce risks and protect individuals. Our focus is on developing tools and processes that promote equity, reliability, and trust, supported by ongoing monitoring and continuous improvement.

Joining Money Mart means contributing to a future-focused organization that values both innovation and integrity, where your work helps shape solutions that responsibly support our employees, clients, and communities.

A Olos é uma empresa brasileira focada em oferecer soluções tecnológicas que potencializem o relacionamento entre empresas e seus clientes. Gerir estrategicamente o ciclo de pagamentos e atuar como um verdadeiro parceiro de negócios das áreas internas e fornecedores. Você será responsável por garantir o processamento ágil e impecável das obrigações financeiras no ERP Omie, otimizar prazos de pagamento, aplicar conhecimentos sólidos de matemática financeira em negociações e assegurar o rigor da conciliação bancária, apoiando diretamente a saúde e a previsibilidade do fluxo de caixa da companhia.

  • Gestão de Pagamentos e Domínio do Omie: Liderar a rotina de contas a pagar com autonomia total no ecossistema Omie, garantindo a correta inserção de notas fiscais, classificações financeiras, rateios por centro de custo e provisionamentos.

  • Gestão do Fluxo de Caixa (DPO): Estruturar, monitorar e otimizar a régua de pagamentos para maximizar o DPO (Days Payable Outstanding), apoiando a tesouraria na elaboração de projeções financeiras confiáveis.
  • Conciliação e Compliance Bancário: Controlar as remessas e retornos de arquivos CNAB (pagamentos e varredura), executar conciliações bancárias diárias e solucionar divergências junto aos bancos, garantindo que o Omie reflita fielmente as saídas do caixa.
  • Análise e Melhoria de Processos: Elaborar relatórios de aging de fornecedores e estruturar fluxos de aprovação de despesas, identificando gargalos e propondo automações para ganho de escala;

Requisitos Indispensáveis

O que não pode faltar

  • Formação superior completa em Matemática, Estatística, Contabilidade, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Domínio absoluto em Faturamento no ERP Omie: É imprescindível saber lançar, classificar e baixar títulos com total autonomia, segurança e domínio técnico no módulo de Contas a Pagar do sistema.

title: Communications Associate em maceió (AL)
description:
Drive UNOPS' global presence and impact through compelling content creation and strategic communication initiatives.

About the Region

In Latin America and the Caribbean, UNOPS operates across 23 countries, delivering high-impact solutions that drive sustainable development. UNOPS focuses on building and improving resilient infrastructure—including roads, bridges, public facilities, sanitation systems, and housing—to enhance quality of life and foster inclusive growth. UNOPS also supports public health by procuring essential medicines and medical equipment, ensuring broader access to healthcare services. By strengthening institutional capacities, UNOPS promotes transparent, efficient, and equitable public management. As a trusted partner to governments and development stakeholders, UNOPS aligns its interventions with national priorities, helping countries advance the Sustainable Development Goals through practical, results-driven support.

About the Country/Multi-Country Office

Based in Brazil, the UNOPS Southern Cone Multi-Country Office (SCMCO) also oversees operations in Argentina, Paraguay, and Uruguay, supporting national priorities and development goals across the subregion. In Argentina, UNOPS strengthens public institutions by providing technical assistance in planning, procurement, and oversight of infrastructure projects—particularly in public buildings—and building capacity in public procurement, with a focus on technological innovation. In Brazil, where UNOPS has operated since 2012, the office collaborates with UN agencies, financial institutions, and government bodies at all levels to deliver services in health, education, urbanization, social rehabilitation, PPPs, and institutional strengthening. UNOPS has played a key role in responding to the COVID-19 pandemic and currently manages 17 active projects across the country. Its work emphasizes transparency, operational efficiency, and results-driven management while aligning with the strategic and operational needs of its partners. Across the Southern Cone, UNOPS promotes sustainable development by enhancing national capabilities and supporting the delivery of high-impact, inclusive infrastructure.

Job Specific Context

Role Purpose

The Communications Associate contributes to developing and implementing communication efforts to enhance UNOPS’ visibility and reputation. The position is responsible for creating and editing a wide range of content, including web stories, press releases and social media posts, ensuring all materials align with corporate style and partner requirements. The incumbent also supports external communications and media relations, helping to coordinate events and campaigns. The Communications Associate is a proactive professional who can manage content production, assist with communications planning, and provide essential administrative support related to communication plans.

Functions / Key Results Expected

Communications Implementation and Visibility

  • Assist in identifying opportunities to strengthen visibility and outreach nationally, regionally and globally.
  • Ensure communication deliverables meet partner/donor visibility requirements and UNOPS guidelines.
  • Support the implementation of project communication strategies and stakeholder mapping.
  • Contribute to crafting project narratives aligned with UNOPS corporate style.

Content Development and Production

  • Draft, edit and proof-read communication materials: web stories, newsletters, press releases, reports and social-media content.
  • Support production of multi-media products (infographics, videos, photos), ensuring message consistency.
  • Coordinate communication inputs for events, workshops and campaigns.
  • Serve as a focal point for internal communications queries.

External Communication and Media Outreach

  • Support messaging that enhances UNOPS and project positioning at the national/ regional level.
  • Assist in managing media relations.
  • Support crisis and reputation communication where needed.
  • Contribute to the production of outreach materials and press interactions.

Documentation and Administrative support

  • Assist in developing Terms of Reference (ToRs) and technical specifications for the procurement of communication services.
  • Prepare requisitions, payment requests, and maintain inventories of materials.
  • Support gender-responsive communication activities and related reporting.

Knowledge Building and Sharing

  • Support the organization, facilitation and delivery of training and learning sessions on communications topics.
  • Participate in knowledge-sharing initiatives and Communities of Practice (CoPs), contributing insights and lessons learned from communications project implementation,
  • Conduct research on communication-related topics and contribute to the drafting of reports, summaries and briefing notes.

Ser Klabin

Você já pensou em fazer parte de uma empresa centenária, líder nos mercados de embalagens de papelão ondulado e sacos industriais com muita história para contar, e ao mesmo tempo inovadora, sustentável e que sempre te desafia a ser melhor?

Nossa missão é ser referência mundial em soluções responsáveis que atendam às constantes transformações da sociedade, com produtos de base florestal de usos múltiplos, renováveis, recicláveis e biodegradáveis .

A base do negócio da Klabin são as árvores, nos tornamos referência mundial no manejo sustentável de florestas e mantemos mais de 40% das nossas áreas destinadas à conservação e à manutenção da biodiversidade . Temos orgulho em ser a primeira empresa brasileira a fazer parte do Índice Dow Jones de Sustentabilidade (DJSI).

Trabalhamos para criar uma cultura de desenvolvimento permanente, que valoriza a meritocracia , reconhecendo a dedicação e esforço de cada um.

E nós acreditamos que diferentes histórias, raças, crenças, orientações sexuais, idades, gêneros, regiões, culturas e deficiência de qualquer natureza amplias e enriquecem a nossa visão de mundo. E por isso fazemos parte do Mover – Movimento pela Equidade Racial e do Fórum de Empresas e Direitos LGBTI+.

Conheça Nosso Desafio

Você será responsável por liderar a operação produtiva, garantindo o cumprimento das metas de segurança, qualidade, produtividade, custos e eficiência operacional. Atuará diretamente na gestão das equipes, acompanhamento dos indicadores industriais e condução de ações de melhoria contínua, assegurando a estabilidade e performance da operação. O principal desafio será liderar uma operação de manufatura contínua com forte interface com máquinas de papel, promovendo o desenvolvimento das equipes, a evolução da cultura de segurança e TPM, além da obtenção de resultados sustentáveis para o negócio.

Para Este Desafio Você Precisará Ter

  • Ensino Superior completo em Engenharia, Administração, Gestão Industrial, Produção Industrial ou áreas correlatas.

  • Vivência em liderança de equipes operacionais.
  • Experiência na gestão de indicadores industriais (produtividade, qualidade, segurança e custos).
  • Conhecimento e aplicação de TPM.
  • Experiência em planejamento e acompanhamento da produção.
  • Vivência em melhoria contínua e resolução de problemas.
  • Experiência em fabricação de papel.
  • Vivência prática com operação de máquina de papel.
  • Experiência em ambiente de manufatura contínua.
  • Disponibilidade para atuação presencial em Goiana/PE.

Diferenciais

  • Pós-graduação em áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência na indústria de papel e celulose.
  • Vivência com papel para embalagens.
  • Conhecimento em WCM.
  • Conhecimento em Lean Manufacturing.
  • Conhecimento em SAP.
  • Conhecimento em Power BI.
  • Experiência em grandes operações industriais.
  • Experiência em implementação e desenvolvimento da cultura TPM.

Conheça um pouco do que oferecemos para você e sua família:

  • Vale Refeição (Somente para o Escritório Sede em São Paulo) ou Refeitório e Vale Alimentação para ajudar nas compras do mercado;

  • Educação: Formação técnica em Eletrônica, Eletrotécnica ou áreas correlatas. Certificações específicas em aviônicos serão consideradas um diferencial.
  • Experiência: Experiência mínima de 5 anos em manutenção de sistemas aviônicos em aeronaves.
  • Certificações: CHT (Certificado de Habilitação Técnica) ativa junto à ANAC, especificamente em AVI (Aviônicos), é obrigatória.
  • Idiomas: Inglês técnico intermediário é essencial para leitura e interpretação de manuais técnicos.
  • Habilidades: Excelentes habilidades de resolução de problemas, atenção aos detalhes e capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão.
  • Conhecimentos Técnicos: Profundo conhecimento em sistemas de navegação, comunicação e controle de voo, além de proficiência no uso de equipamentos de teste e diagnóstico específicos para aviônicos.

Competências Essenciais:

Na Solojet Serviços, valorizamos a segurança, excelência, inovação, integridade e família. Buscamos profissionais que compartilhem desses valores e que estejam comprometidos com o crescimento e a manutenção de altos padrões de qualidade e segurança na aviação executiva.

O profissional será responsável por planejar, executar e fiscalizar as diretrizes de Segurança, Saúde Ocupacional e Gestão Ambiental no canteiro e frentes operacionais de macrodrenagem e dragagem fluvial. Terá como missão prevenir acidentes, garantir o cumprimento das Normas Regulamentadoras (NRs), assegurar a conformidade com as condicionantes ambientais do projeto e controlar os impactos das intervenções em meio aquático e urbano.

Principais Responsabilidades e Atribuições:
Segurança e Saúde Ocupacional:

Cumprir e fiscalizar as políticas de SMS da organização e os procedimentos operacionais padrão da obra;

Realizar inspeções diárias de segurança nos canteiros fixos, canteiro itinerante e frentes móveis (dragagem, terraplenagem, aduelas e TASS);

Elaborar e ministrar Diálogos Diários de Segurança e Meio Ambiente (DDSMA);

Identificar perigos, avaliar riscos e propor medidas de controle por meio de inspeções e monitoramentos ambientais/ocupacionais;

Emitir, validar e acompanhar Permissões de Trabalho (PT), Análises Preliminares de Risco (APR) e Ordens de Serviço (com foco em trabalhos a quente/termofusão de PEAD, altura, escavações e içamento de cargas);

Especificar, inspecionar e controlar o fornecimento de EPIs (com atenção especial ao uso obrigatório de coletes salva-vidas nas operações embarcadas) e EPCs (tapumes, guarda-corpos e sinalizações);

Conduzir e registrar investigações de acidentes, incidentes e desvios, alimentando o Diário de Obra e relatórios técnicos com planos de ação corretivos;

Acompanhar e gerenciar os indicadores de desempenho em SMS da obra;

Apoiar a gestão da CIPA, brigada de emergência e simulações de atendimento a emergências (incluindo resgate aquático);

Ministrar treinamentos admissionais (integração) e periódicos para as equipes operacionais.

Gestão e Controle Ambiental (Operacional):

Fiscalizar a implementação e o cumprimento do Plano de Gestão Ambiental Operacional (PGAO) e do PGRCC (Resolução CONAMA nº 307/2002);

Controlar e monitorar a rastreabilidade dos sedimentos dragados e resíduos, assegurando a correta emissão e arquivamento de MTRs (Manifestos de Transporte de Resíduos) e Certificados de Destinação Final (CDF) para faturamento e medições;

Inspecionar a instalação, posicionamento e integridade das Barreiras Anti-Siltagem no rio para contenção da pluma de turbidez;

Acompanhar a operação ambiental do Tanque de Acúmulo, Sedimentação e Secagem (TASS) e a qualidade do retorno do efluente clarificado ao curso d’água;

Fiscalizar o armazenamento e transporte de resíduos perigosos e comuns gerados nos canteiros e nas manutenções de maquinários;

Inspecionar máquinas e equipamentos quanto a vazamentos de óleos/combustíveis, verificando a utilização de óleos biodegradáveis em sistemas sobre lâmina d’água e a prontidão dos kits de mitigação/absorção de derramamento;

Monitorar a destinação e higienização dos sanitários químicos móveis e o funcionamento dos tanques sépticos/filtros das instalações provisórias;

Apoiar a interface da obra com a comunidade lindeira e com as equipes do Trabalho Técnico Social (PTS), orientando os colaboradores quanto à postura socioambiental e minimização de incômodos urbanos (ruído, poeira e bloqueios).

Requisitos e Qualificações:
Formação Técnica em Segurança do Trabalho concluída, com registro ativo no Ministério do Trabalho (MTE);

Diferencial: Formação complementar, curso técnico ou especialização em Meio Ambiente / Gestão Ambiental;

Experiência comprovada em obras de infraestrutura pesada, drenagem, terraplenagem, saneamento ou serviços marítimos/fluviais/dragagem;

Conhecimento prático da legislação ambiental básica, Resoluções CONAMA (ex.: 307/2002) e emissão/controle de MTR estadual/nacional;

Domínio das NRs (especialmente NR-01, NR-06, NR-12, NR-18 e NR-35);

Lutamos para proteger as meninas contra às violências, garantindo que cresçam livres, respeitadas e conscientes de seus direitos, em um mundo justo e equitativo para todas as pessoas.

Com projetos implementados em mais de 130 comunidades no Maranhão, no Piauí, na Bahia e em São Paulo, e atuando em rede com o terceiro setor e movimentos sociais, alcançamos todo o território nacional.

O que fazemos todos os dias abre caminhos para um Brasil justo e digno, onde meninas crescem com segurança, respeito e liberdade.
